scope: All four assets, four volatility windows, seven horizons; equal weight per series and one squared-loss observation per daily origin
primary_inference: Two-sided Diebold-Mariano with HLN horizon7, Bartlett HAC33 and Holm adjustment across the four declared references in2026
sensitivity_holm: Same four references adjusted together for each bandwidth and year separately; sensitivity is not a separate acceptance route
secondary_windows: 7/14/21/28 individually, HAC window+5; Holm4 per window and year, descriptive without joint adjustment across windows/years
strong_retrospective_improvement_rule: Lower global2026 MSE and favorable DM-Holm4 p<.05 versus ALL FOUR declared references at HAC33, and lower global2025 MSE than original model
macro_metrics: Compute per asset/window/horizon then average. MacroRMSE is mean of individualRMSE, not sqrt(globalMSE)
baseline_comparison: SVR versus persistence and simple daily-target HAR-OLS, Holm2 per year; published hybrid and new AR shown separately
time_integrity: AR coefficient/hyperparameter selection restricted to2024. Residual of origin s/horizon h usable after s+h<=current origin close; coefficients stay fixed in2025/26
selection_limit: Base hyperparameters were preselected over all2024. AR validation conditional on this representation is not nested independent model-selection validation
inspection_limit: 2025 and cached2026 Jan01-Aug24 were already examined. Passing this rule is retrospective evidence only and does not restore an untouched confirmatory period
chronology_correction: Retain truthful history: diagnostics added after original modeling; development-only reconstruction cannot retroactively make EDA prior to modeling
publication_gate: No publication in this task. Stronger evidence must be reviewed; no automatic GitHub/Render action even if statistical criterion passes
